# What is a sleep reset score? How Sleep Reset turns your routine into a bedtime plan

When a sleep schedule drifts — late nights, heavy mornings, a weekend that undoes the week — advice like "sleep more" does not say where to start. Sleep Reset is our iPhone app that starts with a number instead: answer its onboarding questions about your goals and routine, and it gives you a free sleep reset score and a recovery outlook. This guide explains what the score is, what the paid plan adds, and our first measured month, reported honestly.

## How does the score work?

The score is built from your answers, not from a sensor. During onboarding the app asks about your goals and your current routine, then returns two things for free: a sleep reset score, which summarises how far your routine is from the one you are aiming at, and a recovery outlook, which shows the direction your next days could take if you follow the plan. It is a starting point for a routine, not a prediction of your results and not a medical assessment.

## What does the paid plan add?

A paid subscription unlocks the working parts of the reset:

- **A personalised reset plan** built from your score, instead of generic advice.
- **Bedtime timing**, so the plan lands on an actual clock time in your evening.
- **Guided breathwork** — follow the breathing count as part of your bedtime routine.
- **Next-morning steps**, so the reset continues after you wake up instead of ending at the pillow.

Sleep Reset requires iOS 18.0 or later.

## Our first measured month, honestly

In the 28 days from 10 October to 6 November 2026, App Store Connect recorded 305 impressions and 4 downloads for Sleep Reset — the smallest start of any app we publish. We are publishing the number anyway. This blog exists so that the measured record, good or bad, is public and dated; if the score idea is going to earn its audience, it will have to do it from 4 downloads upward, and future articles in this category will report whether it did.

## Common questions

**Is the sleep reset score free?**

Yes. The score and the recovery outlook are free. The personalised plan, bedtime timing and guided breathwork require a paid subscription.

**Is the score a medical assessment?**

No. It is a routine-based starting point, not a diagnosis. If sleep problems persist or seriously affect your days, talk to a clinician.

**Which devices can I use?**

Sleep Reset is for iPhone and requires iOS 18.0 or later. Check the App Store for current compatibility.

**Where can I get Sleep Reset?**

On the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6762143790), and you can read more on the [Sleep Reset product page](/sleepreset).
